subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: What should the empty-plugin-scope and gateway empty-startup paths do with already registered agent harnesses during reload: preserve all, preserve only lifecycle-stable owner/bundled harnesses, or clear them and gate/retry dispatch until readiness returns?
rationale: Current source confirms the lifecycle hazard, but the safe permanent behavior depends on maintainer intent for plugin-owned harness disablement, bundled provider harness availability, and gateway reload semantics.

options.title: Preserve owner-valid harnesses
options.body: Keep harnesses whose owner remains enabled or process-stable while clearing disabled plugin-owned harnesses, with tests for bundled/provider and third-party plugin cases.

options.title: Restore every prior harness
options.body: Adopt the open PR's simpler restore-all approach and accept that explicit empty-scope reloads may retain third-party harnesses until a later lifecycle cleanup.

options.title: Clear and gate dispatch
options.body: Keep strict clearing semantics but add a readiness or bounded retry path so channel events do not fail during controlled reload windows.

recommendation.title: Preserve owner-valid harnesses
recommendation.body: Keep harnesses whose owner remains enabled or process-stable while clearing disabled plugin-owned harnesses, with tests for bundled/provider and third-party plugin cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The harness registry and nearby lifecycle behavior appear to originate in Peter Steinberger's commits, making `steipete` the best available owner for the registry contract decision.
